descriptive_title: Grade 2 Mathematics: Demonstrations — Likelihood with Spinners and Dice (D2.1-D2.2)
short_description: A 5-day Grade 2 unit on likelihood framed around Lucky Lou the Loon and Maybe Mae the Cat. Children review I/P/C, learn complementary events, predict with spinners and dice, and predict mode across groups.
long_description: Continue the likelihood adventure with Lucky Lou and Maybe Mae! This 5-day Ontario-aligned Grade 2 unit covers both D2 expectations (D2.1, D2.2) building on the Grade 1 unit. Day 1 reviews IMPOSSIBLE/POSSIBLE/CERTAIN with Canadian context. Day 2 introduces COMPLEMENTARY EVENTS (heads/tails, rain/no rain). Day 3 explores spinners — bigger sections more likely. Day 4 explores dice and finds the MODE. Day 5 closes with a Mode Prediction Capstone where children predict mode in their class then test in another. Includes 5 lesson plans with expanded walkthroughs (each tackling a Grade-2 trap: all-possible default, not-strictly-complementary, small-section trap, same-mode-always, same-mode-different-group), 5 student worksheets, 12 paper manipulatives, formative + reflection sheets, full assessment suite with 2-row summative rubric, and Junior Likelihood Detective G2 certificates.
target_buyer: Ontario Grade 2 teachers looking for a fully scaffolded 5-day likelihood unit (D2.1-D2.2).
subject: Mathematics
pedagogical_approach: Hands-on probability with character-driven detective frame, structured pair work, and clear predict-test-report cycle.
